landing.hero_desc: Log expenses in seconds, schedule due dates, get WhatsApp alerts, and never forget a birthday or rent payment again.
landing.hero_fineprint: No credit card. No install. Privacy by design.
landing.features_title: Everything you need to stay in control
landing.feature_expenses_desc: Log an expense or income in 5 seconds and see your monthly net (what comes in minus what goes out). Filter by month, year, category or amount. 8 currencies with live conversion.
landing.feature_ocr_desc: Snap a photo and AI extracts amount, merchant, date and category. You just confirm.
landing.feature_wa_desc: Share split bills or alerts via WhatsApp in one click — opens the chat with the message ready to send.
landing.feature_reminders_desc: Medical appointments, birthdays, whatever you need. With configurable lead time.
landing.feature_metrics_desc: What comes in, what goes out and what is left. Charts by category, income vs expenses and month-over-month comparisons.
landing.feature_shopping_desc: Multiple lists (grocery, pharmacy). Tick items while you shop. Clear with one click.
landing.step1_title: Sign in with Google or email
landing.step1_desc: One click with Google or a magic link to your inbox. No passwords or long forms.
landing.step2_desc: With the camera, by typing, or from a past receipt. Default categories included.
landing.step3_desc: Add your number and the ones you want. We'll alert you before every due date.
landing.final_cta_desc: Takes less time to start than to set up a spreadsheet.
landing.hero_desc_free_list: income & expenses, bill splitting, budgets, calendar, shopping, push and shared spaces.
landing.feature_nl_desc: Type "I spent 5000 at the supermarket" in Search (⌘K). Same Pro plan as OCR.
landing.feature_budgets_desc: Monthly cap by total or category. Push alert at 80% and when you cross it. Free.
landing.feature_wa_desc_pricing: Share via WhatsApp from the app in one click. Push notifications always free.
landing.step3_desc_alt: Push is always free. Manual WhatsApp is free. Automatic with a paid plan if you want it.
landing.step2_desc_alt: By hand, with the camera, by typing "I spent X on Y" (Pro), or by letting Kumo detect recurring expenses.
landing.plans_subtitle: Expenses, reminders, shopping, push and shared spaces — at no cost.
landing.plan_ocr_desc: Scan receipts or type in natural language. Gemini interprets, you confirm.
landing.plan_wa_desc: Kumo alerts you automatically before due dates and reminders.
landing.plan_bundle_desc: Scan receipts and let Kumo alert you via WhatsApp.
landing.plans_footnote: Prices in Argentine pesos. We may adjust them if international costs rise significantly, with prior notice.
